cover.coreProposition: 技能路由应是版本化、可归因的选择平面事件：它决定哪些技能材料进入上下文，但不能生成工具调用权限，也不能证明后续执行或业务结果成功。
cover.visualMetaphor: A cyan skill token moves through an amber selection lens toward a separate luminous permission seal and a distant result beacon.
cover.semanticObject: A cyan skill token traveling from a selection lens toward a separate permission seal.
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with three clearly separated symbolic moments, strong directional flow, restrained geometry and generous negative space
